name: test and scan
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test_and_scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service: [tasks-api, title-normalizer]
        python-version: [3.12, 3.11, 3.8]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
  
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
  
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r services/${{ matrix.service }}/requirements.txt
    
      - name: run tests
        run: pytest services/${{ matrix.service }} | tee ${{matrix.python-version}}-${{matrix.service}}-test-results.txt
      
      - name: upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: ${{matrix.python-version}}-${{matrix.service}}-test-results
          path: ${{matrix.python-version}}-${{matrix.service}}-test-results.txt
